text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. All eyes are 
on the rematch between Hishi Amazon and 
Narita Brian after their fierce clash last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fired up for their fateful one-on-one 
showdown, Hishi Amazon and her rival sent 
fierce sparks flying even before the race. 
The curtains on the decisive battle have 
finally opened—!
